SELECT

    a.SEC_CSNAME AS `股票名称`,

            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_RATIO,0) +
            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_RATIO,0) +
            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_JAPAN_RATIO,0) +
            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_KOREA_RATIO,0) +
            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_TW_RATIO,0) +
            COALESCE(a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_RATIO,0)
        ), 2

    ASTK_REVENUE_OVERSEAS a
